title: Extending Context Window of Large Language Models via Positional Interpolation
authors: S. Chen, S. Wong, L. Chen, Y. Tian
before: A model trained at 2K tokens broke down badly past that length.
problem: Retraining from scratch at longer context is prohibitively expensive.
breakthrough: Scale RoPE position indices down to fit the trained range, then fine-tune briefly. 32K context from a 2K model in a thousand steps.
why: It made long context an affordable post-hoc upgrade rather than a training-time commitment.
next: YaRN and LongRoPE refined it; nearly every long-context open model uses some variant.
inherits: Context extension as a cheap fine-tuning step.
